A-line midi skirt, falling just below the knee, dark chocolate #3E2B26, soft wool blend with a subtle woven texture
Single-breasted coat, straight cut, knee length, camel #B88B5A, brushed wool blend
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, espresso #2B1D18, smooth leather

This outfit sits right in the neat band: a refined knit with a skirt and ankle boots feels put-together without looking like you are trying too hard for a casual restaurant. The burgundy and chocolate are warm, rich autumn tones that glow in the soft artificial light of an evening dinner, and the knit gives you a flattering, romantic neckline.
